description: This PHP source file defines the 'Customer' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the database table 'ohrm_customer' using Doctrine ORM. It includes properties for customer ID, deletion status, name, description, and related projects, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the database with properties for ID, deletion status, name, description, and related projects.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the customer is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the customer as deleted or not.
